# jupyasyncclient

> Async kernel client for Jupyter Server via HTTP/WebSocket

## Modules

- [jupyasyncclient.files](https://AnswerDotAI.github.io/jupyasyncclient/files.html.md): Files and cells over the gateway's contents and cells APIs
- [jupyasyncclient.sessions](https://AnswerDotAI.github.io/jupyasyncclient/sessions.html.md): Async client for Jupyter sessions over `/api/sessions`
- [jupyasyncclient.ssh](https://AnswerDotAI.github.io/jupyasyncclient/ssh.html.md): SSH-over-WebSocket ProxyCommand client, session store, and `.ssh/config` updater for Rustygate, Solveit, and Colab
- [jupyasyncclient.term](https://AnswerDotAI.github.io/jupyasyncclient/term.html.md): A client for gateway-hosted terminals: REST lifecycle plus one websocket attachment
